blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is mourning the death of Fire Officer 2 Josdine Manalastas, who died while participating in a rescue operation involving four people trapped by rising river waters in Tayabas City, Quezon, on Thursday. Manalastas, 32, was among the firefighters deployed to rescue a family trapped beneath a bridge when river water rose rapidly, the BFP said. During the operation, Manalastas went missing.
